role: Test double conforming to HealthKitServiceProtocol with only its requirements: every query answers "no HealthKit data" (empty sleep, no Watch HR estimate, zero training load, nil vitals, exports succeed); daytimeRestingHR is the one settable answer (HRVAnalysisPipelineTests). Used by MorningProcessingServiceTests, HRVAnalysisPipelineTests, ReanalysisServiceTests, SleepBoundaryResolverTests, SessionImmutabilityTests, DemoSessionSeederTests.
toplevel: No top-level code. fetchDaytimeNapMinutes and estimateSleepFromRR are not implemented, so the protocol extension defaults (0 nap minutes; HealthKitManager.estimateSleepFromHR on the RR series) are used.
